items.title: Mozambique: Chigamane golf course project breaks ground as Inhambane targets global golf tourism market
items.summary: The initiative was announced by the Presidency following a ceremony in Chigamane, a locality in the tourist district of Vilankulo, Inhambane province, where Mozambican President Daniel Chapo laid the foundation stone for the construction of the golf courses In a statement, the Presidency said the development represents an investment in diversifying Vilankulo’s tourism offer, seeking to strengthen the district’s ability to attract visitors and consolidate its position as a leading destination in national and international tourism markets “The initiative aims to attract tourists from various regions of Mozambique and countries such as South Africa, Zimbabwe, Tanzania and Zambia, creating conditions to stimulate the local economy, encourage business development and expand the participation of national operators in the tourism value chain,” the statement said The project forms part of the broader strategy established by the Government to develop golf tourism in Inhambane province.

items.title: Poland begins two days of mourning over Krakow shooting
items.summary: Mourners left candles in Krakow's main market square to honor the victims of the attack. Police confirmed that the bodies found at the suspect's home were those of his parents and sister Poland began two days of mourning on Sunday, a day after killed six people and wounded 15 others were shot in Krakow's main market square The attack occurred in Main Square ( Rynek Glowny ) in the Old Town of Poland's second-largest city on Saturday. The area is a popular tourist attraction In addition to the six people killed in the square, three bodies found at the suspect's home were the bodies of his sister, mother and father, police said Sunday Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has labeled the attack an act of far-right "terrorism," but authorities have not given a possible motive Mourners left candles in the square to pay tribute to the victims of the shooting.

items.title: EUMAM MOZ supports Lar Nossa Senhora dos Desamparados with essential supplies
items.summary: The initiative was attended by the EUMAM MOZ Force Commander, Brigadier General Sérgio Estrela, who, accompanied by Mission personnel, visited both the female and male residential wards of the care home. Beyond the delivery of the donated items, the visit provided opportunities for interaction and engagement with the residents in an atmosphere of fellowship and sharing, enabling Mission personnel to gain a better understanding of the realities and challenges faced by this community Photo: European Union Military Assistance Mission in Mozambique The Nossa Senhora dos Desamparados Care Home carries out valuable social assistance work that requires a continuous response to the needs of its residents.

items.title: South Africa's ANC facing worst-ever performance in local elections
items.summary: Near-final results show South Africa's once dominant ANC will see its lowest-ever vote percentage. The party is taking the blame for shoddy municipal services, including water and electricity shortages South Africa's African National Congress (ANC) is heading for an historically poor election performance , with the near-final tally from Wednesday's municipal polls showing it coming in with just over 30% of the vote The ANC also lost its majority in six of the eight metropolitan regions, South Africa's Electoral Commission said Saturday in sharing the results after 98% of votes were counted South African voters in 2026 are angry about water and electricity shortages, with the ANC taking the blame for the poor state of municipalities. High unemployment, crime, and widespread corruption are other pressing issues ANC leader, and South African president, Cyril Ramaphosa , has not yet addressed the poor performance as of Saturday evening.
